queries: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS bench FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.film_count, p.avg_ratio / b.bench AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-rating averages, computed only over ratings present among films with rental_duration > 5 (the filter applies before the benchmark is computed).
Number of films is the count of all films in each rating group satisfying the filter (COUNT(*)), including any whose rental_rate/rental_duration is NULL.
Rows with NULL rating, if any, form their own group and are included in the output and in the benchmark.

The number of films counts all films in each rating group after the filter (COUNT(*)), including any with a NULL rating value forming its own group if present.

responses.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS benchmark FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.film_count, p.avg_ratio / b.benchmark AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE b.benchmark IS NOT NULL AND b.benchmark <> 0

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is computed over the per-rating averages of the filtered films only (rental_duration > 5), not over all films; 'all ratings' means all rating groups present in the filtered set.
Film count is the number of films in each rating group after the rental_duration > 5 filter (COUNT(*)).
A zero benchmark is also excluded to avoid division by zero; it cannot occur in practice since rental_rate is at least 0.99.
